自从酒会后，陆清韵那边没有丁点反应，但是席墨这边却是发难了。

唐隐完全不知道酒会上发生了什么，所以他在发现公司态度一百八十度大转变的时候，整个人都懵圈了。

最后从时笙那里得知真相的唐隐哭晕在厕所。

闹丑闻没关系，咱们还可以洗白。

可是你把老板得罪了是几个意思？

不想混了吗？

唐隐看着对面依旧一脸无所谓的时笙，嘴角抽搐了好几下，这都被人雪藏了，她还这么不急不慌的。

“你现在打算怎么办？”她和东方娱乐可还有两年半的合同。

东方娱乐这边不给资源，就算他们自己出去找，谁敢拂了东方娱乐的面子？

“等着呗。”

“等着？”等着做什么？等着人老珠黄不成？

这艺人，就是吃青春饭的，真要是被雪藏个一两年，在想混，可就难了。

时笙眉眼一弯，笑得毫无诚意，“对啊，等着。”

唐隐一口气堵在胸口，这真的是他家的艺人啊，不是派来折磨他的？

时笙说等着，她还真的整天不见人影，唐隐这个经纪人自然也闲得慌。

一个月后。

时笙刚踏进公司，就听到不少人在议论唐隐。

她一路上去，也将事情听了个大概。

啧啧，她这么久没来，唐隐竟然过得这么惨。

“没想到啊，这唐隐竟然是唐家的私生子，这长得和唐家人一点也不像……”

“哪个唐家？”

“还能是哪个唐家……”

“想听八卦进去听啊，躲在外面听有什么意思。”

“你疯了，唐家大小姐还在里面……”回答的那人疑惑的回头，看清站在她后面的人，顿时站直了身子，还拉了几下身边的人。

时笙冲她们恶劣的笑了笑，伸手推开门进去。

“拽什么拽，不过是被公司雪藏的艺人，如今又摊上这么个经纪人，怕是一辈子也别想翻身了。”

Since the cocktail party, there was no reaction from Lu Qingyun, but Xi Mo got angry.

Tang Yin had no idea what happened at the reception, so when he discovered that the company's attitude had changed drastically, he was completely confused.

Tang Yin, who finally learned the truth from Shi Sheng, cried and fainted in the toilet.

It doesn't matter if there is a scandal, we can still clear our name.

But what does it mean when you offend your boss?

Don't want to mess around anymore?

Tang Yin looked at Shi Sheng across from him who still had an indifferent expression. The corners of his mouth twitched several times, but this was all hidden by others. She was still so calm and unhurried.

"What are you going to do now?" She still has a two-and-a-half-year contract with Oriental Entertainment.

Oriental Entertainment doesn't provide resources. Even if they go out to find it themselves, who would dare to offend Oriental Entertainment's face?

"Just wait."

"Waiting?" Waiting for what?Do you want to wait until you grow old and grow old?

This artist is a man who thrives on his youth. It would be very difficult if he was kept hidden for a year or two and tried to get around.

Shi Sheng arched his eyebrows and smiled without sincerity, "Yes, wait."

Tang Yin breathed heavily in his chest. Is this really his artist? Wasn't he sent to torture him?

Shi Sheng said wait, but she really hadn't been seen all day, so Tang Yin, the manager, was naturally very busy.

One month later.

As soon as Shi Sheng stepped into the company, he heard many people talking about Tang Yin.

Along the way, she also heard an overview of the matter.

Tsk, tsk, she hasn't been here for so long, and Tang Yin is actually having such a miserable life.

"I didn't expect that Tang Yin is actually the illegitimate son of the Tang family. He looks nothing like the Tang family..."

"Which Tang family?"

"Who else could it be from the Tang family..."

"If you want to hear gossip, go in and listen. What's the point of hiding outside and listening."

"Are you crazy? The eldest lady of the Tang family is still inside..." The person who answered turned around in confusion and saw the person standing behind her. He immediately stood up straight and pulled the people around him a few times.

Shi Sheng smiled evilly at them, stretched out his hand to open the door and went in.

"What are you dragging? It's just an artist who has been hidden by the company. Now that he has such an agent, I'm afraid he won't be able to turn around for the rest of his life."
